body.purpose: Prose and form content. Inputs run 16px on mobile to prevent iOS zoom, dropping to 14px at the md breakpoint.

title.purpose: Card and panel titles. Same size as body — weight (500) is the only signal.

label.purpose: The workhorse: table cells, list rows, sidebar items, nav links, button text.

label-strong.purpose: Buttons, badges, active nav items, font-medium table cells.

section-title.purpose: Dialog, panel and subsection headings — text-xl font-semibold. Named by role, not picked by size.

page-title.purpose: The single top heading on a dashboard screen — text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight.

caption.purpose: Badges, xs buttons, chart ticks, tight metadata. 12px is not a working size.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Card and resting-surface separation. Not a shadow — the Ring Rule's only mechanism.

shadows.name: float-lg
shadows.purpose: Dialogs. Dialogs are capped at 90vw x 90vh.

shadows.name: brutalist-offset
shadows.purpose: Preset only (data-theme-preset=brutalist). Hard offset, no blur — permitted nowhere else.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing in the system. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: press-offset
motion.purpose: The system's entire input feedback: active:translate-y-px on buttons.

motion.name: hover-wash
motion.purpose: Filled buttons drop to 80% on hover; ghost/wash states use 4-8% foreground.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action. Fill drops to 80% on hover, presses 1px on active.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg class="ds-btn-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg>Get started</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)); color: var(--be-primary-foreground, oklch(0.9911 0 190.05)); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), outline-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary .ds-btn-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Half-strength border at rest, full primary on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)) 50%, transparent); color: var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)) 4%, transparent); border-color: var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The only field style. 12px radius so it never reads as a button; border carries error state.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--be-input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); background: transparent; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: var(--be-foreground, oklch(0.2478 0 0)); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--be-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-foreground, oklch(0.2478 0 0)) 20%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--be-destructive, oklch(0.6532 0.2328 25.74)); } .ds-input:disabled { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-input, oklch(0.922 0 0)) 50%, transparent); opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The unit of grouping. Same white as the page, separated only by its ring.
components.html:
Sales summary
Earnings and payouts for the selected period.
Lifetime earnings, available payout, and recent orders.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--be-card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--be-card-foreground, oklch(0.2478 0 0)); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-foreground, oklch(0.2478 0 0)) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card-header { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: var(--be-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-card-content { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: 20px tall, 16px radius. Status variants are a 10% wash, never a solid slab.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)); color: var(--be-primary-foreground, oklch(0.9911 0 190.05)); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge--positive { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.49 0.192 149.58) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(0.49 0.192 149.58); } .ds-badge--destructive { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.6532 0.2328 25.74) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(0.6532 0.2328 25.74); } .ds-badge--outline { background: transparent; border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-foreground, oklch(0.2478 0 0)) 92.2%, transparent); color: var(--be-foreground, oklch(0.2478 0 0)); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Pill-shaped row. Current page is signalled by fill + weight, never a left border.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-item" aria-current="page"><svg class="ds-nav-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 3v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16"/><path d="M7 15l4-4 4 4 4-6"/></svg>Insights</button>
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--be-sidebar-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item .ds-nav-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item[data-open] { background: var(--be-sidebar-accent, color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-foreground, oklch(0.2478 0 0)) 8%, transparent)); color: var(--be-accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--be-sidebar-accent, color-mix(in oklab, var(--be-foreground, oklch(0.2478 0 0)) 8%, transparent)); color: var(--be-accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--be-primary, oklch(46% 0.214 259.815)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Linket's interface is a shop counter, not a showroom. The counter is where goods are laid out, where the transaction happens, and where the person behind it stands all day. That means the chrome is quiet and the products are loud: our own UI should recede so a creator's links, products, orders and payouts are the most visible thing on screen. The dashboard is a working surface — scannable at a glance, dense where density helps, never decorative for its own sake.

The system is semantic-token driven end to end. Nothing in a component is allowed to name a raw color; every surface, border and label resolves through the --be-* variables that a theme supplies. The default record is neutral and near-achromatic (white paper, ink-grey text, hairline borders) with exactly one chromatic accent — a working blue — reserved for actions. Dark mode is a first-class twin, not an afterthought: it remaps the same token names rather than introducing new ones.

Expressiveness is delegated, not absent. A creator's public page is theirs to make loud; the dashboard that builds it stays restrained. When a decision is close, choose the quieter surface.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic tokens only — no raw color values in components
One working blue as the single decorative accent; status colors are earned by meaning
Flat by default, separated by a 1px ring rather than shadow
Generous, pill-like control radius (24px) against 12px fields and 16px badges
4px spacing grid; 24px card padding; 14px/16px working type sizes
Logical properties everywhere — the UI is RTL-ready by construction

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: No raw color ever appears in a component. text-muted-foreground, never text-gray-200. If a value isn't in the token set, the token set gets a new entry — components don't get a hard-coded escape hatch.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Counter Blue is the only decorative accent on a screen. Status colors may appear only when they report real state. If you need a second brand color to make a screen work, the screen's hierarchy is wrong, not its palette.

rules.name: The Two-Size Rule
rules.body: Working UI runs on exactly two sizes: 16px for reading and input, 14px for controls, tables and navigation. 12px is for badges and metadata only. If you're reaching for a third working size, the content wants to be restructured, not rescaled.

rules.name: The Weight-First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with weight before size. Titles and body are both 16px; they differ by 100 weight. Reserve size jumps for genuine section breaks.

rules.name: The One-Container Rule
rules.body: Every dashboard page centers on max-w-7xl. A page that needs more width is a page that needs a table with horizontal scroll, not a wider container.

rules.name: The Ring Rule
rules.body: Containers are separated by ring-1 ring-foreground/10. If two surfaces need to be told apart and a ring won't do it, they aren't the same level of the hierarchy — restructure rather than add a shadow.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces have no shadow. Shadow is a response to state (hover, open, elevated), never a starting condition.

rules.name: The Three-Radius Rule
rules.body: Only 24px (controls/cards), 16px (badges) and 12px (fields) exist. A fourth value means a component is being styled outside the system.

dos: Do express every color through a semantic token — bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border.
Do separate surfaces with ring-1 ring-foreground/10 and leave them shadowless at rest.
Do build on the 4px grid: 12/16px inside controls, 24px inside cards, 20px between sections, max-w-7xl for page content.
Do use logical properties (ps-/pe-/ms-/me-) so the UI keeps working in RTL.
Do keep focus visible — focus-visible:outline-2 in primary on every interactive element.
Do keep 16px for reading and input, 14px for controls and tables, 12px for badges.
Do establish hierarchy with weight (400 vs 500) before changing size.
Do give status color a real status to report — green means confirmed, red means destructive or invalid.
donts: Don't hard-code a hex, rgb() or a Tailwind palette class like text-gray-200 in a component.
Don't put a resting shadow on a card, panel or section.
Don't nest a card inside a card — use Card.Content sections or a plain bordered group.
Don't invent a radius, a border width or a type size outside the scales above.
Don't use #000 or #fff directly for text or grounds; the neutrals are tinted (Soft Ink, Sheet White) and pure values break the ladder.
Don't add a second accent color to a screen, or use status colors decoratively.
Don't reach for physical directional styles (ml-, mr-, left-, right-) in shared components.
Don't remove or soften the focus outline, and don't add bounce or elastic easing — the press is the only input motion.
